description: Read an event report. Use metric=performance with section=sales for sales and revenue; summary and sales retain the event setup summary.

eventId.description: Event ID. Defaults to active event.

filters.description: Native Performance filters, such as currency or payment-plan start_date and end_date. Requires metric=performance.

metric.description: Report to read. summary and sales return the event setup summary. Use performance and section=sales for sales and revenue.

options.description: Native Performance options, such as currency and group_by. Requires metric=performance.

section.description: Native Performance section; join several with |. Requires metric=performance.

name: get_event_performance
title: Get event performance
